versionPolicy.v0.8.1Purpose: Add the public platform landing page, curate the repository, record current dependency/link provenance, and preserve the Version 0.8 questionnaire/result protocol boundary without moving v0.8.0.

authoritativeCurationGate.name: Synchronize the tested v0.8.1 curation candidate once
authoritativeCurationGate.note: This one-time workflow ran the locked install, dependency comparison and audit, all automated test layers, release build/synchronization, current-document link audit, and public/private-boundary checks. It then removed itself and committed the exact generated outputs and reports.

dependencyComparison.policy: Do not upgrade only because a newer registry version exists; change dependencies for demonstrated security or supported-browser compatibility needs, or in a separately scoped and re-evaluated toolchain migration.
